purpose: Recognition, application alternatives and restraint controls from the newly read Zinsser mechanics and nonfiction-form chapters. Retrieval and fixture checks do not measure semantic judgment.

recognition.query: A draft has redundant adverbs, decorative adjectives or timid-sounding qualifiers. An editor proposes removing may, somewhat or approximately to sound authoritative.
criteria: Retrieve the complete candidate with its source caveat and exceptions.
Distinguish applicable mechanism from a genre-dependent or historical prescription.

execution.draft: The siren shrieked loudly. The crack may be slightly wider than yesterday.
execution.instruction: Compare an application and an alternative under the supplied purpose and invariants.
execution.reference_response: The siren shrieked. The crack may be slightly wider than yesterday.
alternative_responses: The siren gave a shriek. The crack may be slightly wider than it was yesterday.
criteria: The siren's loud sound remains.
A wider crack is possible, not established.
Any possible increase remains slight.
Respect the requested mode; do not add unsupported facts.

non_application.draft: Only the pale-blue folders belong in the return bin.
criteria: The color narrows which folders to return; it is functional even if the noun often has a familiar color.

cases.exception_anchor: An evidential hedge is not a defect merely because it reduces confidence.

recognition.query: A report hides a known action behind a noun chain. A passive sentence is criticized without checking whether an agent is supplied.
criteria: Retrieve the complete candidate with its source caveat and exceptions.
Distinguish applicable mechanism from a genre-dependent or historical prescription.

execution.draft: Context: The intake team reviewed the requests. Draft: Completion of request review was achieved by the intake team.
execution.instruction: Compare an application and an alternative under the supplied purpose and invariants.
execution.reference_response: The intake team reviewed the requests.
alternative_responses: The requests were reviewed by the intake team.
criteria: The intake team is the known reviewer.
The action is review, not approval.
Respect the requested mode; do not add unsupported facts.

non_application.draft: The east window was broken overnight; no one saw who did it.
criteria: Do not invent a vandal or accuse a resident just to turn a passive into an active sentence.

recognition.query: A sentence changes time frame or direction only at its end. A reader may attach a new description to the previous sentence's subject.
criteria: Retrieve the complete candidate with its source caveat and exceptions.
Distinguish applicable mechanism from a genre-dependent or historical prescription.

execution.draft: Last year the clinic opened at eight. It opens at seven this year.
execution.instruction: Compare an application and an alternative under the supplied purpose and invariants.
execution.reference_response: Last year the clinic opened at eight. This year it opens at seven.
alternative_responses: The clinic now opens at seven, rather than last year's eight.
criteria: Last year's opening time is eight.
This year's opening time is seven.
Do not invent a reason for the change.
Respect the requested mode; do not add unsupported facts.

non_application.draft: The moon rose. Along the wall, the cats became visible.
criteria: The spatial connection is already intelligible; no automatic therefore or however is needed.

cases.exception_anchor: A connective must not invent causation or opposition.

recognition.query: Closely dependent sentences have been split into a chain of tiny paragraphs. A dense block contains a clear change from background to an instruction.
criteria: Retrieve the complete candidate with its source caveat and exceptions.
Distinguish applicable mechanism from a genre-dependent or historical prescription.

execution.draft:
The gate remained locked.

The key was inside.

We waited for the caretaker.

By noon, the delivery had been cancelled.
execution.instruction: Compare an application and an alternative under the supplied purpose and invariants.
execution.reference_response:
The gate remained locked. The key was inside. We waited for the caretaker.

By noon, the delivery had been cancelled.
alternative_responses: The gate remained locked, with the key inside. We waited for the caretaker. By noon, the delivery had been cancelled.
criteria: The gate remains locked and the key is inside.
The group waits for the caretaker.
Cancellation occurs by noon, without an invented cause.
Respect the requested mode; do not add unsupported facts.

non_application.draft:
Open the door.

Stop if you smell smoke.
criteria: Distinct action and safety condition can warrant separate short units; do not join them merely to satisfy a paragraph-length preference.

cases.exception_anchor: A short paragraph can provide legitimate emphasis.

recognition.query: An editor calls every semicolon old-fashioned or demands only short sentences. A long sentence mixes independent stages without a controlled relationship.
criteria: Retrieve the complete candidate with its source caveat and exceptions.
Distinguish applicable mechanism from a genre-dependent or historical prescription.

execution.draft: The tide reached the steps, the rescue boat was still beyond the pier.
execution.instruction: Compare an application and an alternative under the supplied purpose and invariants.
execution.reference_response: The tide reached the steps; the rescue boat was still beyond the pier.
alternative_responses: The tide reached the steps. The rescue boat was still beyond the pier.
criteria: The tide reaches the steps.
The rescue boat is still beyond the pier.
No causal relation or rescue outcome is added.
Respect the requested mode; do not add unsupported facts.

non_application.draft: The town had one rule: leave the eastern path clear.
criteria: The colon introduces the rule effectively; a source's dislike of colons is not a reason to change it.

cases.exception_anchor: A semicolon or colon can be the clearest choice.

recognition.query: A general instruction assumes every participant has the same gender. A rewrite changes singular duties into a collective duty while neutralizing a pronoun.
criteria: Retrieve the complete candidate with its source caveat and exceptions.
Distinguish applicable mechanism from a genre-dependent or historical prescription.

execution.draft: Every volunteer must submit his own timesheet.
execution.instruction: Compare an application and an alternative under the supplied purpose and invariants.
execution.reference_response: All volunteers must submit their own timesheets.
alternative_responses: Each volunteer must submit an individual timesheet.
criteria: Every volunteer must submit a timesheet.
The obligation remains individual, not one shared sheet.
Respect the requested mode; do not add unsupported facts.

non_application.draft: The interview transcript records, 'My brother brought his notebook.'
criteria: This is a specific attributed statement, not an exclusionary generic instruction; do not replace the supplied relationship or pronoun.

cases.exception_anchor: A specific person's supplied identity and pronouns should not be silently replaced.

recognition.query: An opening delays the actual event behind vague drama. A report tells readers something is astounding but never shows the supplied fact.
criteria: Retrieve the complete candidate with its source caveat and exceptions.
Distinguish applicable mechanism from a genre-dependent or historical prescription.

execution.draft: Context: The archive reopened Monday after six months of repairs. Draft: What a moment! Nobody could believe what was finally happening. A new chapter was beginning.
execution.instruction: Compare an application and an alternative under the supplied purpose and invariants.
execution.reference_response: The archive reopened Monday after six months of repairs.
alternative_responses: After six months of repairs, the archive reopened Monday.
criteria: The archive reopens Monday.
Repairs lasted six months.
No crowd reaction or visitor experience is invented.
Respect the requested mode; do not add unsupported facts.

non_application.draft: The reading rose from 2 to 4. For this instrument, 4 is the shutdown threshold.
criteria: The second sentence supplies necessary significance; do not remove it merely to let readers marvel on their own.

cases.exception_anchor: Readers may need an explanation of scale or significance.

recognition.query: An editor wants to join remarks from different days into one seamless interview. A nonfiction scene invents dialogue or an interviewee's thoughts for narrative flow.
criteria: Retrieve the complete candidate with its source caveat and exceptions.
Distinguish applicable mechanism from a genre-dependent or historical prescription.

execution.draft: Context: On Monday Lee said, 'The pump stopped.' On Friday Lee said, 'We replaced the valve.' Draft: 'The pump stopped, so we replaced the valve,' Lee said.
execution.instruction: Compare an application and an alternative under the supplied purpose and invariants.
execution.reference_response: On Monday, Lee said, 'The pump stopped.' On Friday, Lee said, 'We replaced the valve.'
alternative_responses: On Monday, Lee reported that the pump had stopped; on Friday, Lee said the valve had been replaced.
criteria: The two statements came on different days.
Do not fabricate a quoted connective or one continuous utterance.
No causal connection is established by the supplied source alone.
Respect the requested mode; do not add unsupported facts.

non_application.draft: The source records one continuous sentence: 'The pump stopped, so we replaced the valve.'
criteria: The connective and continuous quotation are supported; do not split or challenge them merely because composites are sometimes misleading.

cases.exception_anchor: Separate remarks must not be presented as a single exchange without support.

recognition.query: A place description substitutes quaint or charming for distinguishing details. A writer turns a few observed people into a claim about everyone in a culture.
criteria: Retrieve the complete candidate with its source caveat and exceptions.
Distinguish applicable mechanism from a genre-dependent or historical prescription.

execution.draft: Context: I watched three customers wait outside the locked bakery at 6:50. Draft: This town is obsessed with bread.
execution.instruction: Compare an application and an alternative under the supplied purpose and invariants.
execution.reference_response: At 6:50, three customers were already waiting outside the locked bakery.
alternative_responses: I noticed three customers waiting outside the locked bakery at 6:50.
criteria: There are three observed customers.
The bakery is still locked at 6:50.
Do not infer a town-wide motive.
Respect the requested mode; do not add unsupported facts.

non_application.draft: Request: A visitor needs to know where the beach entrance is and whether the path has steps.
criteria: Ordinary access facts are necessary for this audience; do not cut them because they would be familiar attributes in a different kind of travel essay.

cases.exception_anchor: A single observation does not prove a national trait.

recognition.query: A memoir draft summarizes an entire life without an organizing focus. A polished version invents an exact date, smell, quotation or motive absent from the writer's memory.
criteria: Retrieve the complete candidate with its source caveat and exceptions.
Distinguish applicable mechanism from a genre-dependent or historical prescription.

execution.draft: I think it was winter when I learned to repair the kettle with Dad. He kept the old screws in a tea tin. We also lived in three different towns and I later changed careers twice.
execution.instruction: Compare an application and an alternative under the supplied purpose and invariants.
execution.reference_response: I think it was winter when I learned to repair the kettle with Dad. He kept the old screws in a tea tin.
alternative_responses: Dad kept the old screws in a tea tin. I remember learning to repair the kettle with him, though I am not sure of the season.
criteria: The season remains uncertain.
Dad keeps old screws in a tea tin.
No dialogue, emotional lesson or new remembered detail is invented.
Respect the requested mode; do not add unsupported facts.

non_application.draft: Request: Make a complete factual timeline for my biography, preserving every residence and career change.
criteria: Do not impose a narrow memoir scene on an authorized comprehensive timeline.

cases.exception_anchor: Memoir construction is not permission to fabricate factual detail.

recognition.query: A technical explanation uses a term before defining its role. An effect appears before the operation needed to explain it.
criteria: Retrieve the complete candidate with its source caveat and exceptions.
Distinguish applicable mechanism from a genre-dependent or historical prescription.

execution.draft: Context: A sensor measures the tank's water level; the controller stops the pump when the level reaches the mark. Draft: The controller stops it at the mark using the sensor.
execution.instruction: Compare an application and an alternative under the supplied purpose and invariants.
execution.reference_response: A sensor measures the tank's water level. When the level reaches the mark, the controller stops the pump.
alternative_responses: The controller stops the pump when the sensor reports that the tank's water has reached the mark.
criteria: The sensor measures the water level.
The controller stops the pump at the mark.
No sensor accuracy, safety guarantee or extra mechanism is invented.
Respect the requested mode; do not add unsupported facts.

non_application.draft: For an expert team: The controller uses the agreed level signal to stop the pump at the setpoint.
criteria: Do not automatically add a elementary lecture when the audience and shared definitions are established.

cases.exception_anchor: Expert readers may not need elementary definitions.

recognition.query: A scientific explanation uses a familiar image but hides where the comparison stops. A metaphor assigns intention or memory beyond what the described system supports.
criteria: Retrieve the complete candidate with its source caveat and exceptions.
Distinguish applicable mechanism from a genre-dependent or historical prescription.

execution.draft: Context: The program stores queued jobs and processes them one at a time. Draft: The queue is a waiting room where jobs get impatient.
execution.instruction: Compare an application and an alternative under the supplied purpose and invariants.
execution.reference_response: The queue is like a waiting room: jobs wait their turn, and the program processes one at a time. The jobs do not feel impatience.
alternative_responses: The queue stores jobs in order, and the program processes them one at a time.
criteria: Jobs are stored and processed one at a time.
Jobs have no supplied feelings or intentions.
The analogy supplies access, not evidence.
Respect the requested mode; do not add unsupported facts.

non_application.draft: In a comic personification: The queued jobs grumbled about the wait.
criteria: A clearly framed fictional or comic personification need not be condemned as a literal technical error.

cases.exception_anchor: An analogy is not factual evidence for a mechanism.

recognition.query: A customer notice announces an enhancement but never states the concrete change. A bureaucratic sentence has several possible plain-language translations.
criteria: Retrieve the complete candidate with its source caveat and exceptions.
Distinguish applicable mechanism from a genre-dependent or historical prescription.

execution.draft: Context: From Tuesday, customers can submit returns through the online form; telephone returns remain available. Draft: Return-processing channel functionality will be augmented effective Tuesday.
execution.instruction: Compare an application and an alternative under the supplied purpose and invariants.
execution.reference_response: From Tuesday, you can submit returns through the online form. Telephone returns will still be available.
alternative_responses: We are adding an online returns form Tuesday. You can still request a return by telephone.
criteria: The online form is an additional option beginning Tuesday.
Telephone returns remain available.
No faster refund, new deadline or guarantee is promised.
Respect the requested mode; do not add unsupported facts.

non_application.draft: Context: This technical specification distinguishes throughput capacity from latency. Draft: Capacity is 80 requests per second; median latency is 40 milliseconds.
criteria: Do not translate distinct technical quantities into a vague promise that the system is fast.

cases.exception_anchor: Plain wording must not add an unsupported promise.

recognition.query: A fluent revision adds concrete examples absent from the original. An editor changes remembered or possible information into a confident general claim.
criteria: Retrieve the complete candidate with its source caveat and exceptions.
Distinguish applicable mechanism from a genre-dependent or historical prescription.

execution.draft: Original: I wondered whether the neighbors were too busy to visit. Candidate: The neighbors spent every evening watching television and had no time for friendship.
execution.instruction: Compare an application and an alternative under the supplied purpose and invariants.
execution.reference_response: I wondered whether the neighbors were too busy to visit.
alternative_responses: Were the neighbors too busy to visit? I could not tell.
criteria: The neighbors' actual motive is unknown.
No television habit is supplied.
The thought remains a question, not a finding.
Respect the requested mode; do not add unsupported facts.

non_application.draft: Context: The user supplies a log showing the neighbors watched television every evening and asks to include that verified detail.
criteria: An authorized supported addition is not invention; check its source and scope instead of banning all new wording.

cases.exception_anchor: Improved cadence does not establish factual fidelity.
